edges.subject: lysosomes
edges.quote: Lysosomes are implicated in a wide spectrum of human diseases, including monogenic lysosomal storage disorders (LSDs), age-associated neurodegeneration, and cancer.

edges.subject: CLN3 disease
edges.quote: CLN3 disease, an autosomal recessive neurodegenerative LSD.

edges.subject: CLN3 disease
edges.quote: Metabolic profiling of isolated lysosomes revealed massive accumulation of glycerophosphodiesters (GPDs) in patients' lysosomes.
